title: Email urgency triage
summary: Identify time-sensitive language in an inbox.
why: A priority badge needs one urgency signal rather than an email summary.

urgent.instructions: Does this email explicitly describe a time-sensitive problem or near-term deadline?

state.email: Production is down. We need the fix before this afternoon launch.

limitation: Synthetic examples demonstrate an integration pattern. Validate on representative labeled data before choosing a model or an operating threshold.
